name: Jiangsu Guofu Hydrogen Energy Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Guofu Hydrogen Energy Equipment Co., Ltd. develops, makes and sells key equipment for the hydrogen energy industry, including vehicle high-pressure hydrogen supply systems, complete hydrogen refueling stations and water electrolysis hydrogen production machines. It also supplies integrated liquid hydrogen solutions and storage vessels. Pin Fang Wu founded it in 2016, and it is headquartered in Suzhou.
